html:
A South Korean drama series released on Netflix in September 2021, created by Hwang Dong-hyuk. In it, 456 people deep in debt play children's games for a huge cash prize, and the losers are killed.

Hwang had written the script years earlier, inspired by his own money troubles after the 2008 financial crisis. The show is a sharp picture of inequality and household debt in South Korea, which many viewers abroad recognised in their own countries. Its green tracksuits, pink guards and the giant doll of "Red Light, Green Light" spread fast online.

It became Netflix's most watched series. In 2022 Hwang won an Emmy for directing and Lee Jung-jae for lead actor, the first time a series not in English won those awards. Seasons two and three followed in 2024 and 2025.

With Gangnam Style, BTS and the film Parasite, it marks the height of the Korean Wave.
